DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Leukemia (likely Acute Myeloid Leukemia).

The peripheral smear showing immature cells with "needle-shaped" inclusions (Auer rods) alongside normal coagulation studies is pathognomonic for acute leukemia. Given your age of 67, this is highly suggestive of Acute Myeloid Leukemia. I will proceed with a bone marrow biopsy to confirm the cell lineage and genetic mutations.
